subject: reasoning
question: In a coded language, BOUND is coded as 20, TRAIL is coded as 50 then find the code of COMPUTER
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b7c2347d68e52a2cd731fac52abf1581d2fb91f4d4f0c5bd540f0332caf4d9a.png] 

Logic: Sum of position values of consonant

BOUND is coded as 20

Consonants in BOUND: B, N, D

Sum of positional values of consonants = 2 + 14 + 4 = 20

And,

TRAIL is coded as 50

Consonants in TRAIL: T, R, L

Sum of positional values of consonants = 20 + 18 + 12 = 50

Similarly,

COMPUTER is coded as

Consonants in COMPUTER : C, M, P, T, R

Sum of positional values of consonants = 3 + 13 + 16 + 20 + 18 = 70

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.
